clippy.scope: DOM, JS, layout and native libraries, warnings denied

changes: Primary-document ID lookup follows document-local tree order, not an arena-wide cache.
Native Document child edges and embedding cycles are rejected before mutation.
Rejected insertBefore operations leave Range endpoints and tree state unchanged.
Focus retargets through explicit document hosts; inactive documents return null activeElement.
Native document replacement validates and targets its explicit Document receiver.
Document write buffers are receiver-scoped, retain the aggregate 1 MiB budget, and hold native leases released on close and binding teardown.
Two-frame interleaved document writes preserve parent and sibling identities and execute scripts in the corresponding frame realm.
Detached-document write tests cover independent buffers, inert scripts, reopening and budget rejection/recovery.
remaining: Full HTML incremental dynamic-markup behavior, native document ownership/adoption, AgentRuntime and subsequent R/W cutovers remain incomplete. No related-window sharing activation. Range.insertNode crash remains unresolved and was not rerun in this batch. Earlier signed evidence applies only to its recorded source.
